# TRAPSTAR Room 01 Package v0.1

Canonical portable design package for Trapstar room 01 with metadata-first content.

## Canonical package contents

- `README_FIRST.md`
- `PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json` (full source manifest from upstream package)
- `REPOSITORY_PROFILE.json` (this repository’s consumption contract)
- machine-readable docs, schemas, catalogs, provenance, and QA metadata
- production room and character metadata (manifests + anchors/profiles), excluding full render libraries
- selected lightweight preview images in `reference/previews/`

The companion full-resolution production package is kept outside normal repository history as:
`TRAPSTAR_ROOM_01_RESTRUCTURED_ASSET_PACKAGE_V01.zip`
